release.notes:
Human Shuffle now has separate Word Builder and Sentence Builder choices. Choose a lesson set, then prepare a matching challenge. Next challenge stays within that lesson and style; reopening restores the saved round.

Question Bank > Human Shuffle can create and rename lesson sets, assign existing challenges, and upload challenges into a selected set. Existing challenges remain under Unsorted until assigned.

The CSV template includes an optional Lesson Set column and can prefill the selected lesson title. Older four-column files and the Sentence Shuffle mode name still work. Duplicate detection is per set; the 200-challenge bank limit remains.

Preserves existing challenges, prepared cards, rounds, scores and the 0.1.109 improvements. Windows update only.
